sources.snippet: Full-topology GGUF conversions of upstage/Solar-Open2-250B, preserving all 48 layers, 320 routed experts, and one shared expert. This is an independent conversion and is not an official Upstage release.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts model that closes these gaps and advances Solar Open 1 along four axes. First, it scales up from 102B to 250B total parameters, raising the model's capacity for knowledge and reasoning.

sources.title: [2607.20062] Solar Open 2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts language model built for long-horizon agentic tasks, scaled up from Solar Open 1 (Solar Open 100B). sources.title: Solar-Open2-250B — VRAM, Quants & GPU Compatibility
sources.snippet: Solar-Open2-250B by upstage — 250.29B parameter other model with 1M context. Minimum 165GB VRAM (Q4_K_M quantization). Compatible with 2 GPUs, cloud rental from $3.06/hr. 3 quantization options available.
